reason: Both alerts (java/xss and java/sql-injection) originate from user input ('param') flowing into the 'sql' variable. Since the resolved sink value excludes attacker-controlled input for both the SQL sink (Line 47) and the XSS sink (Line 50-56), both alerts are False Positives.
